title: In Turkey when Kennedy was assassinated
summary: The band was in Ankara when the agent woke them with the news, and the tour was cut off.

blocks.x: In 1963 you were in Europe at the time that President Kennedy was assassinated.
Yes, we were in Turkey, Ankara, I think it is.
in Turkey when the news came

Well, we were -- we had gone to bed in this hotel, and our agent, government agent came around and knocked on the door and said, 'We're leaving. They've assassinated our President.' So tomorrow, the next day we got together and left. No, it was that next day or two days, couple of days (unintelligible). But one thing, the whole country seemed to close up in commemoration of the President; they really observed that incident.
How much longer did the tour have to run?
Oh, we had -- we were supposed to go back to -- what's that little country -- Greece and places. We probably had a couple of weeks more, but they cut it right off.
